gen-orbitron-gf-fragment-mono: Minimal, spaced-out, almost surgical. Orbitron stretches its letters wide along the line, while Fragment Mono lines up its tall, rule-straight monospace characters beneath without any stroke contrast to interrupt them.
gen-orbitron-gf-geist-mono: Orbitron's letters sit far apart, each with a big open eye. Geist Mono follows in fixed-width, code-style monospace, its tall lowercase and wide side gaps giving paragraphs a steady, technical stride.
gen-orbitron-gf-major-mono-display: Orbitron spreads its letters far apart with wide-open apertures. Major Mono Display brings its tube-like, neon-glass monospace strokes and generous sidebearings, so one handles bold precision while the other adds a glowing, technical texture.
gen-orbitron-gf-martian-mono: Precise, with every letter of Orbitron spaced far apart and each e showing a big, clear eye. Martian Mono echoes that looseness in fixed-width monospace.
gen-orbitron-gf-spline-sans-mono: Orbitron opens with wide, spread-out letters and easily readable apertures, minimal and exact. And Spline Sans Mono matches that precision, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals in a fixed-width monospace.
gen-orbitron-gf-victor-mono: Orbitron spaces its letters far apart, leaving a large, clear eye on every e. Victor Mono answers that precision in monospace, its magnified-looking text and loose spacing making the pair feel structured above all.
gen-orbitron-newsreader: Orbitron stretches wide and geometric, joining its strokes at full width with no hairline thinning. But Newsreader, a classic serif, keeps its strokes lightly modulated and open, so one makes display statements while the other carries the reading.
gen-orbitron-source-serif-4: Source Serif 4 gives the body a dignified, lightly tightened stroke at curve tops. Under Orbitron's heavy-bowled, wide-set display letters, a longer passage would read steadily, with weight changes that never turn dramatic.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps its curves generous and low in contrast. Press Start 2P brings the retro punch with pinned-apart letters, while the plain sans body does the quiet, modern work of being readable.
gen-press-start-2p-fs-chillax: Relaxed and a bit goofy, Chillax draws loose, unfinished loops under Press Start 2P's pinned-apart retro letters. A longer passage in this sans-serif would feel casual, with the line wandering like a bent straw.
